# Your First Agent

This chapter is your hands-on starting point: define an agent, send it a message, and get a reliable, typed result back.

## This Chapter Will Cover

- The `Agent { ... }` declaration syntax and the “callable agent” model
- Providers and models (enough to get running; not an exhaustive survey)
- Writing system prompts that support deterministic orchestration
- Single-turn calls vs multi-turn conversations (we’ll keep it single-turn for now)
- Extracting useful results from the agent response

## The Running Example Starts Here

We’ll begin a simple workflow we can grow through Part II:

1. Take a messy `raw_notes` string (meeting notes, a chat transcript, or a pasted doc excerpt)
2. Have an agent produce a draft recap email (subject + body + action items)
3. Later, add tools + human approval before any “send” step

*Warm-up example:* `code/chapter-01/04-basics-simple-agent.tac`
